description: Web page to markdown for AI agents: fetch one URL and get its main content as clean, LLM-ready markdown (navigation, ads, footers and scripts removed) with title, description, language, word count and a token estimate. Uses the site's own Markdown version when it offers one. Useful for RAG, summarizing articles, research and feeding pages to an LLM. Not charged if the page can't be fetched or isn't text. Paid via x402; see list_prices.

url.description: Absolute HTTP or HTTPS URL of the page to read.

title: Read a web page as markdown
